name: yxj-paper-os
description: Reader-first, evidence-bound paper revision with matched-journal writing calibration, durable author directions, claim-bearing display production, recurrence repair, impact closure, and canonical artifact verification.

interface.shortDescription: Reader-first revision that closes repeated feedback.
interface.longDescription: YXJ Paper OS is a returning paper revision authority with a non-negotiable evidence boundary. It resolves repository-declared authority, re-enters by material delta, calibrates wording, sentence patterns, and organization against verified same-journal exemplars, preserves stable author directions, diagnoses repeated findings, applies explicit revisions across every affected surface, and proves the canonical rendered artifact matches the current source without rewriting shared Git history.
capabilities: Explicit assess, design, revise, and audit intent
Reader-first problem, claim, contribution, and story design
Same-journal, same-article-type writing calibration from verified exemplars
Non-negotiable scientific evidence boundary with minimal sufficient defense
Stable author directions and recurrence root-cause repair
Claim-bearing figure and table production from editable sources
Direct writeback with cross-surface impact closure
interface.defaultPrompt: Use YXJ Paper OS as the paper revision authority. Resolve repository-declared authority and the current material delta first. When target-venue language or structure matters, verify a same-journal, same-article-type, same- or related-topic cohort, extract recurring wording, sentence, and organization patterns, and apply only locator-backed patterns without copying prose or changing science. Preserve active stable author directions. If a finding recurs, compare the prior diff, acceptance criterion, source, and artifact, then repair the root cause rather than repeat a local wording patch. Keep every claim within all claim-relevant evidence and serve the reader first. For a nontrivial figure or table, lock its reader question, takeaway, evidence mapping, editable source, final-size visual gate, scientific gate, manuscript integration, and canonical export. Apply only explicitly authorized edits across every affected surface, rebuild and identify the canonical artifact, use fixed cold-reader tasks for global story changes when available, and report impact closure.
